rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas says Abraham and Ishmael did not build with stonework or mud, lacked the help and materials to roof it, and instead marked the site and circumambulated it.
rows.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال أما والله ما بنياه بقصة ولا مدر ولا كان معهما من الأعوان

rows.speaker: الشعبي
rows.claim: Shaʿbi says Abraham asked Ishmael for a stone to mark where circumambulation begins; after rejecting Ishmael’s stone, Abraham brought the Black Stone, sent by one who did not leave him to rely on Ishmael’s stone.
rows.anchor: عن مجاهد عن الشعبي قال لما أمر إبراهيم أن يبني البيت وانتهى إلى موضع الحجر

rows.speaker: بشر بن عاصم
rows.claim: Bishr ibn ʿĀṣim reports Abraham came from Armenia with the sakina, an angel, and a ṣurad bird as guide; the sakina directed him to build there, and even a tyrant feels its calm.
rows.anchor: عن أبي جريج عن بشر بن عاصم قال أقبل إبراهيم من أرمينية معه السكينة والملك والصرد

rows.speaker: أبو قلابة
rows.claim: Abu Qilaba reports God told Adam the House would be circumambulated and prayed at like the Throne; it was raised at the Flood, then Abraham rebuilt it from Hira, Thabir, Lebanon, Tur, and the Red Mountain.
rows.anchor: عن أيوب عن أبي قلابة قال قال الله تعالى يا آدم إني مهبط معك بيتي يطاف حوله

rows.speaker: قتادة
rows.claim: Qatada says Abraham built the House from Sinai, Tur Zayta, Lebanon, al-Judi, and Hira, and that its foundations were from Hira.
rows.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله عز وجل وإذ يرفع إبراهيم القواعد قال ذكر لنا أنه بناه من خمسة أجبل

rows.speaker: عبد الله ابن عمرو
rows.claim: Abdullah ibn Amr says Gabriel brought the Black Stone from Paradise and placed it where it remains; he urges people to hold to it, since Gabriel will soon return it to its origin.
rows.anchor: عن يوسف بن ماهك قال قال عبد الله ابن عمرو أن جبريل عليه السلام هو الذي نزل عليه بالحجر
